inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver was observed not washing their own hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: None of the infants had feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Caregiver was observed not washing child's hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: During inspection, no documentation of fire, inclement weather or lock down drills were available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: No outdoor/playground maintenance logs were available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Infant sheets were observed loose and not tight fitting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Two CPR/First Aid certificates had been altered and/or falsified.  The date taken/expiration date had been changed.  Both employees verified they had not recently taken First CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: Person in charge did not have accesses to all necessary  information when requested by licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that a caregiver failed to properly supervise when they fell asleep while in charge of a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The operation failed to notify Licensing of the director's extended absence or who the designated person in charge would be during the absence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined that the operation did not report a situation involving concerns related to the possible mistreatment of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Controlling Person: The operation failed to report a change of controlling person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: At the time of inspection there was evidence of insects and rodents in many areas at the operation. An on call inspector arrived to confirm rodent activity and recommended temporary closure of the operation for pest treatment and deep cleaning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection: At the time of inspection there were several health inspectoin violations noted on sight by City of Fort Worth Sanitation inspectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3405)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Direct Care for No More Than 10 Hours: It was determined that caregivers worked over 10 hours of direct care on at least one day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Direct Care for No More Than 10 Hours (26 TAC §746.1003(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It was determined that the operation exceeded child/caregiver ratio in at least one classroom with 7 children (SAG - 17 months) and one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: It was determined that a caregiver used a vaporizer in the presence off children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that caregivers failed to provide adequate supervision to children when they fell asleep on duty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: It was determined that the director did not ensure that all staff complied with minimum standards related to discipline, caregiver responsibilities, and safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that caregivers did not demonstrate good judgement, competency or self-control in disciplining, interacting with, and supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined that a caregiver used yelling and harsh tones when disciplining children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: At the time of inspection a loose water hose was observed on the playground whien children were not using the equipment.  This was corrected at inspection when staff disconnected the hose and wound it up to store so that it was inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: At the time of inspection the fence gate for the outdoor space was locked with a combination lock. Caregivers were not aware of the combination code to open the gate. This was corrected at inspection when management provided the code to all staff who verbally acknowledged receiving the code.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the time if inspection several areas at the operation were in need of organzing, cleaning, and maintenance.   The fence separating the 2 playgrounds was observed to be leaning over. A work order has been submitted.   The Pre K classroom was unoccupied due to incoming supply deliveries, this area was disorganied making the space unuseable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: It was determined that an individual used a vaporizer in the building while children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when using a vaporizer on the premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation.    It was determined that the caregiver did not demonstrate courtesy/respect when interacting with a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the time of inspection one child was not current with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using: At the time of inspection a water table on the toddler playground was observed to be full of water. This was corrected at inspection by having staff empty the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using (26 TAC §746.3407(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: At the time of inspection one child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a food allergy response plan in thier file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection, 2 classes at the operation were over the child/caregiver ratio.  The operation camie into compliance by adding another caregiver to one class and several children from the other class were picked up by parnets during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: At the time of inspection an infant was observed sitting in a highchair without safety restraints. This was corrected at inspection by the caregiver removing the child from the high chair so that the straps could be adjusted for size.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection, 2 classes at the operation were over the child/caregiver ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was determined that floors, walls, and other surfaces at the operation were not cleaned or maintained appropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection: It was determined that the operation did not comply with corrections required in the sanitation report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3405)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: At the time of inspection certificates for annual training hours were not available for review at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the time of inspection there was a orange/black cable exposed from the ground posing a trip hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver was notified of the child's injury but did not report it to management so that timely action could be taken. The caregiver was terminated for not following procedures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection there were 13 children in the 2 year old class.  An additional caregiver was added to the class to maintain ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver did not interact with children in a positive manner when the caregiver was observed responding to and redirecting children inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(7))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: It was determined that administrators did not ensure  compliance with minimum standards due to lack of knowledge and good judgment regarding daily operations at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have documentation of a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children's files did not have addresses for the emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director did not have documentation of current SIDS/SBS/EBD training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: None of the infants had updated feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Four caregivers did not have first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include the information from the updated standards..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity plans did not reflect the new requirements for active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: There were 7 children's files that did not have current immunizations or any immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: Four caregivers did not have CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K: None of the children went outside during their scheduled outside time in the morning.  The person in charge stated it was too cold, but the temperature was 45 degrees and sunny.    The person in charge had the children go outside once the concern was addressed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two staff files did not have affidavits of employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's file did not have a health statement from a parent or medical professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: The director did not have current abuse/neglect training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Five garbage cans in the centers were open and accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The operation did not report to Licensing that a child attending the center contracted COVID19.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
